selection.change_behavior: versioned impact preview and human approval

controlled_recalculation.trigger: a material dependency revision makes a downstream object stale
controlled_recalculation.deferral: preserves the stale state, cause, and safest next action
controlled_recalculation.policy: re-evaluate current rights and egress policy before scheduling
controlled_recalculation.revision_rule: recalculation and restoration create immutable revisions
controlled_recalculation.human_authority: an exact human review decision is required before replacing or restoring an approved or adjudicated state

rapid-orientation.title: Rapid field orientation
rapid-orientation.purpose: Establish vocabulary, seminal work, schools, and current debates without claiming systematic completeness.
rapid-orientation.output: Field map, reading path, and contested claims

systematic-review.title: Systematic / scoping review
systematic-review.purpose: Construct and report a reproducible evidence corpus.
systematic-review.output: Protocol, corpus, evidence table, cited synthesis, and audit bundle

living-review.title: Living review
living-review.purpose: Maintain an existing synthesis as evidence and corrections arrive.
living-review.output: Change report, updated synthesis, and affected-claim alerts

theory-synthesis.title: Theory synthesis
theory-synthesis.purpose: Clarify and integrate constructs, mechanisms, theory use, relationships, and boundaries.
theory-synthesis.output: Theory architecture, construct map, mechanisms, and integration opportunities

hermeneutic-inquiry.title: Hermeneutic inquiry
hermeneutic-inquiry.purpose: Deepen understanding through iterative search-read-interpret-memo cycles.
hermeneutic-inquiry.output: Interpretive map, evolving questions, and rationale trail

critical-problematization.title: Critical problematization
critical-problematization.purpose: Surface and challenge assumptions, exclusions, authority arrangements, and foreclosed alternatives.

technical-landscape.title: Technical landscape / benchmark audit
technical-landscape.purpose: Audit methods, baselines, datasets, compute, controls, and evaluation quality.
technical-landscape.output: Benchmark map, missing controls, and study-design opportunities

novelty-audit.title: Novelty & research-opportunity audit
novelty-audit.purpose: Test a proposed contribution against the closest prior work.
novelty-audit.output: Bounded novelty statement and opportunity dossier

empirical-study-design.title: Empirical study design
empirical-study-design.purpose: Turn a corroborated research opportunity and literature evidence into an ethical, feasible, reproducible empirical design.
empirical-study-design.output: Study-design dossier, protocol skeleton, validity and ethics review, and analysis plan

empirical-study-to-article.title: Empirical study to article
empirical-study-to-article.purpose: Move from literature-grounded opportunity through study design and verified study results to an article and adversarial review.
empirical-study-to-article.output: Study protocol, verified result package, full empirical manuscript, simulated reviews, revision, and audit bundle

empirical-results-to-article.title: Empirical results to article
empirical-results-to-article.purpose: Begin from completed empirical work and technical reports, reconstruct the evidence context, and produce a source-grounded article.
empirical-results-to-article.output: Verified result package, literature-grounded empirical manuscript, simulated review, revision, and audit bundle

theory-article-development.title: Theory article development
theory-article-development.purpose: Develop a theory paper from evidence-linked integration, problem framing, and bounded contribution through full manuscript and review.
theory-article-development.output: Theory architecture, article blueprint, full theory manuscript, simulated reviews, revision, and audit bundle

critical-article-development.title: Critical article development
critical-article-development.purpose: Develop an evidence-grounded critical article that challenges assumptions, power relations, exclusions, or dominant problem formulations.
critical-article-development.output: Problematization architecture, critical article blueprint, full manuscript, simulated reviews, revision, and audit bundle

manuscript-review-revision.title: Manuscript review & revision
manuscript-review-revision.purpose: Challenge an uploaded or generated article draft, locate omitted evidence, synthesize independent reviews, and govern revision.
manuscript-review-revision.output: Review package, editorial synthesis, revision plan, revised manuscript, response document, and audit bundle
